name: Iowa

notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
Barber and beauty services, laundry and dry cleaning, and auto repair labor: taxed (FTA 2017 survey answer).
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Iowa's local option tax (1%) is adopted city by city and in each county's unincorporated area; the boundary file records it per address, so each city here shows 1% where most of its addresses carry it. Iowa's posted SST rate file is from 2025 Q3 (the latest on the SST site); its boundary file is 2026 Q4.
